draft.text: You came in for a yearly check-up to see how well your asthma, allergies, and food allergy are being managed.
You are using your medications as prescribed and have not had any asthma flare-ups in the past year.
Your asthma symptoms are stable, and your allergies are under control with your current treatment.
You should keep using your medications as prescribed and continue avoiding peanuts and tree nuts.

unverified_summary.text: You came in because you are trying to reduce your inhaler use to meet the requirements for joining the military.
Your asthma symptoms have stayed the same, with no wheezing, shortness of breath, or coughing.
Your allergies are also under control, with only minor nasal congestion managed by Zyrtec.
Your asthma and allergies are stable, and you have not had any new or worse symptoms since your last visit.
You will continue using Wixela and Zyrtec as prescribed.
You should keep avoiding peanuts and tree nuts to manage your food allergy.
The next steps will be discussed at your next visit.
